Introduce this plugin in the order below, then stop and wait for an answer.

1. One line on what it is for: building an NHCX claims integration into a hospital or payer system, from coverage to payment.
2. What it can do, from the three lists below, one line each. Leave out what does not bear on `$ARGUMENTS` when it is given.
3. Three or four prompts from **Try asking**, picked to suit `$ARGUMENTS` when it is given.
4. Ask what they are building, and whether the code for it exists yet. Then load the one skill below that fits, or dispatch the agent when the goal spans more than one.

## Skills, one per module, each with a prompt to start it

- `nhcx-full`: NHCX, end to end. "Build the whole NHCX integration into this system, on whichever side it sits"
- `nhcx-coverage`: NHCX coverage. "Add NHCX policy search and coverage eligibility to this system"
- `nhcx-preauth`: NHCX pre-authorisation. "Add NHCX pre-authorisation, with the insurance plan and its authorisation requirements, to this system"
- `nhcx-claim`: NHCX claim. "Add the NHCX claim at discharge, and its adjudication, to this system"
- `nhcx-communication`: NHCX communication. "Add NHCX queries, notifications and their acknowledgements to this system"
- `nhcx-payment`: NHCX payment. "Add NHCX payment notices, sent and acknowledged, to this system"
- `nhcx-reprocess`: NHCX reprocess. "Add the NHCX reprocess and shortfall Tasks, asked and answered, to this system"

## Agents

- `nhcx-call-debugger`: Takes one refused or silent NHCX leg and walks it to a named fix, verified by the original leg settling.

## Commands

- `/nhcx-decode-error`: Turn an NHCX refusal into who refused it, what it means, and the named fix.
- `/nhcx-preflight`: Check everything an NHCX send depends on, offline, before the first message goes out.
- `/nhcx-prove-seal`: Prove the JWE seal and open round trip offline, with a test key pair, before blaming the payer.

## Try asking

- "Build the whole NHCX integration into this system, on whichever side it sits"
- "Add NHCX policy search and coverage eligibility to this system"
- "Add NHCX pre-authorisation, with the insurance plan and its authorisation requirements, to this system"
- "What has to be in place before my first NHCX call?"
- "Walk me through the NHCX test cases before go-live"
